description_for_human: Free professional calculators for finance, tax, health, home, unit conversion and more. 48 calculators across 23 categories, 76 conversion pairs, 47 currencies, 9 languages. Includes 2026 GST, VAT, excise duty and customs/tariff calculators.
description_for_model: TrufflShuffl provides 48 free online calculators across 23 categories: Financial (loan, mortgage, investment, bond, amortization, credit-card, debt, net-worth), Investing (investing, retirement, ROI, savings), Business & Tax (VAT, GST, excise duty [AU/UK/US 2026 rates], customs & tariff [US 2026 reciprocal tariffs + EU/UK/AU/CA], percentage, salary, business-tools), Fuel & Travel (fuel, travel), Automotive, EV, Solar, Home Electricity, Water, Home & Garden (pool, paving, renovation, paint), Construction, Health (BMI, calories, body-health), Fitness, Dates & Time (age, time-tools), Fashion (clothing-size, shoe-size, belt-ring), Units (76 conversion pairs), Pets, Food, Education, Engineering, Environment, Lifestyle, Technology. All calculations are client-side JavaScript — no data sent to server. Conversion pages follow the URL pattern /{lang}/convert/{from}-to-{to}/{value}. Data available at /api/v1/. LLM instructions at /llms.txt. Rates last updated 2026-06-26.
